notes.title: Added a 400% Combat Speed option
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added a 400% Combat Speed option.
[*] Made numerous balance improvements (see detailed information in our Discord).
[*] Fixed all known bugs and made improvements to UI/UX.
[/list]

notes.title: Increased PVE and PVP Rewards
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] PVP Rewards increased by 100%
[*] Gold in PVP is gained per won battle, regardless of whether the Arena run was successful.
[*] Decreased the difficulty of the first few gates in PVE Dungeons to allow for better preparation.
[/list]

notes.title: Offline Mode
notes.notes:
After multiple reports, we have added an offline mode for users who are experiencing server connection issues. 

This new mode will both activate and deactivate automatically when needed. 

Additionally, all reported bugs have been patched.

notes.title: A new hero class has been added: Clerics
notes.notes:
- A new hero class has been added: Clerics.
- Three new heroes introduced: Priestess, Elder, and Shaman.
- In PvP dungeons, 2 out of 6 classes are randomly banned.

notes.title: Battlegrounds have been enhanced with new landscape features
notes.notes:
- Battlegrounds have been enhanced with new landscape features.
- Improved taunting mechanics: units positioned closer to the front and center now generate more aggro.
- Item counters have been added to the shops.

notes.title: The new Rogue class has been added to the game
notes.notes:
- The new Rogue class has been added to the game.
- Three new characters have been introduced: Headhunter, Windrider, and Ripper.
- You can now choose your avatar and nickname to display in the PvP arena.

notes.title: A new class has been added: The Knight
notes.notes:
Major Update:
- A new class has been added:  The Knight. This adds three new heroes to the game.
- Buildings can now be upgraded to Tier 3.
- Junk items can now be sold with at the same time using a new sell button.
- Synergies now require unique Heroes to be activated.  Duplicate Heroes do not count towards higher tiers.
- The mana requirement for special abilities now decreases by 20% when Heroes are upgraded to the next tier.
- Chest rewards in Dungeons have been increased in both PVE (+50%) and PVP (+100%).
- All Signet-Merged Artifacts now provide +100% bonuses instead of +50%.
- The Chestplate of Nemesis has been nerfed:  Armor reduced to 60 from 70, Critical Resist reduced from 75% to 50%.
- Heroes now gain an additional +20% Armor and Magic Resistance when upgraded.

notes.title: Version 0.52
notes.notes:
- Rebalanced gold rewards for the Arena. Gold Rewards are now equal to 50 + (Current Rank * 30). Maximum Reward at Rank 25 is 800 Gold.
- Added three (3) new Biomes to the game.
- Fixed narrow passages in pre-existing dungeons.
- Improved the targeting and decision making of Heroes.
- Additional space has been added to the Rebel Camp for Veteran Players.

notes.title: Valefor's Demo: Hardcore Mode
notes.notes: Think of it as a delightful stroll through a park... if the park were full of things that wanted to kill you. Some battles might seem as tough as explaining your internet history, but fear not – every gruesome, soul-crushing challenge is, technically, doable.
